AxisDef.description: How op `construct_axis` builds its axis (externally tagged).

oneOf.description: Through point `a` toward point `b`.
Along one straight edge (a circle edge gives the axis of its circle).
Normal of one planar face, through `through` projected onto the face (default: face centroid).
Axis of one cylindrical or conical face.
Intersection line of two non-parallel planes.

AxisSpec.description: Revolve axis: `"u"`/`"v"` (sketch plane axis through the origin), `"axis:<id>"` (datum axis from `construct_axis`; it must lie in the sketch plane), or a 2D line in the sketch plane.

BodySel.description: `"*"` in field `body` = the only body (error if the count ≠ 1); `"*"` in field `bodies` = all bodies.

CheckItem.description: One check with optional id/note. Note: serde does not support `flatten` + `deny_unknown_fields`, so unknown fields are ignored here.

oneOf.description: Order X, Y, Z.
Exact center of mass (mm) must be within `tol` of `expect` on every axis.
Moment of inertia about an axis through the center of mass, in g*mm^2. Uses the body's mechanical material density (see op `set_material`) unless `density_g_cm3` is given.

Maximum von Mises stress (MPa) of a study result must not exceed `max_mpa`. `study` is the id of a `study` op (`"*"` = the only study). Status is `error` until the study has been run (tool `simulate_static`) and again after the model or the setup changes.
Maximum displacement magnitude (mm) of a study result must not exceed `max_mm`.
Safety factor (yield strength / max von Mises stress) of a study result must be at least `min`.
First natural frequency (Hz) of a `frequency` study must be at least `min_hz`.
Critical load factor of a `buckling` study must be at least `min` (below 1 = buckles).
Highest temperature (deg C) of a `thermal` study must not exceed `max_c`.
Sheet metal: every bend's inner radius divided by the sheet thickness must be at least `min_ratio_to_t` (e.g. 1.0 for mild steel, more for hard alloys).
Sheet metal: the straight length of every flange must be at least `min` mm (tooling needs material to grip; a common rule is 4 x thickness).

Tolerance stack-up of a dimension chain: the total variation of the closing dimension must not exceed `max_total` (mm). `method` is `worst_case` (default, arithmetic sum) or `rss` (root-sum-square, statistical). No geometry is measured: the chain is given explicitly.

DFM (drilling): depth / diameter of every cylindrical hole of the body must not exceed `max_ratio` (standard twist drills: about 4-5; deep-hole tooling: up to 10). Holes narrower than `min_diameter` mm are ignored.

DFM: the material left between every hole wall and the nearest other surface (outer edge, pocket or neighbouring hole) must be at least `min_ratio` x the hole diameter and/or at least `min` mm. Give one or both limits. Measured on the mesh.

DFM (moulding/casting): every planar, cylindrical or conical face that is not a parting face must have at least `min_deg` degrees of draft relative to the `pull` axis (default `z`). Faces perpendicular to the pull direction are parting faces and pass.

DFM (FDM printing): the total area (mm^2) of surfaces overhanging more than `max_deg` degrees from vertical must not exceed `max_area` (default 0). `up` is the build direction (default `z`); faces lying on the build plate are not overhangs.

DFM (milling): internal corners that an end mill travelling along `axis` (default `z`) has to form must have a radius of at least `min` mm. Fails on concave fillets with a smaller radius and on sharp concave edges between two walls parallel to `axis`.

Thread engagement: threaded length / nominal diameter of every thread on the body (ops `thread` and tapped `hole`) must be at least `min_ratio` (rule of thumb: 1.0 in steel, 1.5-2.0 in aluminium, 2.0-2.5 in plastics).

ISO 286 fit of a hole/shaft pair at `nominal` mm, e.g. `hole: "H7"`, `shaft: "g6"`. Passes when the fit is of the wanted `kind` (omit to only compute it) and the clearance stays inside `min_clearance`/`max_clearance` (mm, negative = interference) when given.

ISO 2768-1 general tolerance class of the drawing versus the manufacturing `process`: passes when the process normally holds the requested `class` (`f` fine, `m` medium, `c` coarse, `v` very coarse). The result lists the permitted deviation of the body's overall dimensions for that class.

citation.description: Standard clause or guideline this check enforces, e.g. `"ISO 2768-1:1989, Table 1, class m"`. Printed next to the result in reports.

requirement.description: Id of the design requirement this check verifies (see tool `set_brief`), e.g. `"R2"`. Reports group the results per requirement (traceability matrix).

rule.description: Filled in by rule packs: `"<pack>@<version>/<rule id>"`.

severity.description: `error` (default) blocks the build when the check fails; `warning` is reported only.

ConfigurationSpec.description: One design variant: parameter overrides, suppressed ops and material overrides on top of the base design. The base design itself is the reserved configuration `"Default"`.

material_overrides.description: Body name -> mechanical material used in this variant.

name.description: Unique name (1-48 chars: letters, digits, space, `_`, `-`, `.`); also the build output directory name.

params.description: Parameters overridden by this variant; all others keep their base value.

suppressed_ops.description: Ids of ops skipped in this variant (e.g. an optional hole pattern).

ConstraintSpec.description: Sketch constraint. Entities are referenced by name; points by `"<name>.start" | ".end" | ".center"`.

oneOf.description: `driven: true` = reference dimension: measured from geometry, ignored by the solver.
CCW angle from direction `a` to direction `b`, degrees.
G2 (curvature) continuity between two curve ends (spline–spline or spline–arc), e.g. `{"a": "s1.end", "b": "s2.start"}`; curve `a` enters the joint, `b` leaves it.

DesignBrief.description: The design brief: what is being designed and why. Written before modeling.

cost_target.description: Cost target as free text, e.g. `"< 15 USD at 100 pcs"`.

function.description: What the part has to do, in one or two sentences.

interfaces.description: Mating parts and interfaces (bolt patterns, shafts, envelopes).

loads.description: Loads and operating conditions (forces, torques, temperature).

notes.description: Anything else worth remembering (decisions, open questions).

process.description: Manufacturing process; selects the matching DFM rule pack.

requirements.description: Numbered requirements; every one should be verified by at least one check.

standards.description: Standards the design must follow, e.g. `"ISO 2768-m"`.

title.description: Name of the part or assembly.

EdgeRef.description: Exactly one edge of a body: `{"body":"b","edge":"<edge selector>"}`.

oneOf.description: Exactly one of `center`/`corner` (bottom-left corner). Children: `name.bottom`, `name.right`, `name.top`, `name.left`.
CCW arc from `start_deg` to `end_deg`.
Arc through three points.
Regular polygon with `sides` (3..=64); children `name.0 … name.{n-1}`.
Obround slot between centers `from`–`to` with radius `r`; children `name.0 …`.
Chain of lines; children `name.0 …`.

exact.description: Exact curve (e.g. font glyph outline) as segments chained from `points[0]`; `points` stays the flattened polyline used for snapping/regions.

oneOf.description: Standalone sketch point (reference for snapping/constraints, no profile edge). Referenced in constraints as `"<name>"` or `"<name>.center"`.

FaceRef.description: Exactly one face of a body: `{"body":"b","face":"<face selector>"}`.

oneOf.description: Always a gap (minimum clearance >= 0).
Gap or interference depending on the actual sizes.
Always interference (maximum clearance <= 0).

Fixture.description: A support applied to one or more faces.

faces.description: Face selector (same grammar as modeling ops, e.g. "<X" or "all[kind=cylinder][r=5]").

id.description: Unique id of this fixture; reaction forces are reported per id.

kind.description: How the selected faces are held.

oneOf.description: All three displacement components are zero on the face.
Displacement along the face normal is zero; sliding in the face is free.
Symmetry plane: same constraint as `roller` (no displacement along the face normal). Use it on the cut face of a half or quarter model.

anyOf.description: Custom hole: `diameter` of the main bore; `depth: null` = through. `kind` (default `clearance`) selects the form: `counterbore` uses `cbore_diameter`/`cbore_depth`, `countersink` uses `csink_diameter`/`csink_angle_deg` (default 90), `tapped` uses `thread_pitch`. Omitted form fields fall back to generic defaults.

InertiaAxis.description: Axis through the center of mass: a global axis or a principal axis (sorted by moment).

LineRef.description: A straight line: `"axis:<id>"` (datum axis from op `construct_axis`) or one straight body edge `{"body":"b","edge":"|Z and >X and >Y"}`.

Load.description: A load. `kind` selects the load type and its parameters, for example `{"id":"f1","faces":">Z","kind":"force","newton":[0,0,-100]}`.

oneOf.description: Total force vector in newtons, spread uniformly over the area of the selected faces.

newton.description: Total force [Fx, Fy, Fz] in N.

oneOf.description: Uniform pressure normal to the selected faces.

mpa.description: Pressure in MPa (N/mm^2). Positive pushes on the body (acts along the inward face normal); negative pulls.

oneOf.description: Torque about an axis, applied to the selected faces as tangential forces that grow linearly with the distance from the axis. It is applied as a pure couple (zero net force), so `axis_point` documents where the axis is but does not change the resulting load.

axis_dir.description: Axis direction (need not be normalised); right-hand rule.

axis_point.description: A point on the torque axis, mm.

oneOf.description: Gravity (or any uniform acceleration) acting on the whole body. Uses the body's material density. `faces` must be omitted.

dir.description: Direction the acceleration points to, e.g. [0,0,-1].

g.description: Acceleration magnitude in m/s^2 (9.81 for standard gravity).

oneOf.description: Bearing load on a cylindrical face: a total force distributed as a cosine-shaped pressure over the half of the cylinder that the load pushes against.

newton.description: Total force [Fx, Fy, Fz] in N; normally perpendicular to the cylinder axis.

oneOf.description: A force acting at a remote point, transferred to the selected faces as the statically equivalent force plus moment.

point.description: Point where the force acts, mm.

faces.description: Face selector the load acts on. Required for every kind except `gravity`, which acts on the whole body.

anyOf.description: Key of a built-in or per-file library material (case-insensitive).

MechMaterialSpec.description: Mechanical material: a library key string, or `{"custom": {...}}` with explicit properties.

MechPropsSpec.description: Isotropic material properties at room temperature.

thermal_expansion_per_k.description: Linear thermal expansion coefficient in 1/K; default 0.

yield_strength_mpa.description: Yield strength in MPa (> 0, at most `ultimate_strength_mpa`).

oneOf.description: Voxel hexahedral mesh (engineering estimate, about +/-10 %).

Conforming quadratic tetrahedral mesh (Tet10): follows curved faces and gives better stress near holes and fillets. Falls back to hex with warning `SIM_MESH_FALLBACK_HEX` when the body cannot be meshed.

MeshSettings.description: Mesh controls. With neither `cell_mm` nor `target_elems` the cell size starts at 1/40 of the largest bounding-box dimension and is adapted so the mesh has between 20,000 and 200,000 elements.

cell_mm.description: Explicit cell edge length in mm. Cells are stretched slightly per axis so the grid fits the bounding box exactly. Takes precedence over `target_elems`.

kind.description: Mesh type; only "hex" is supported for now.

target_elems.description: Approximate number of elements to aim for when `cell_mm` is omitted.

Op.description: One modeling step. Field `op` selects the kind; `id` is unique (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$`) and becomes the name of the body/sketch this op CREATES. Ops that MODIFY a body (fillet, chamfer, shell, hole, transform, pattern merge, draft, scale) keep the existing body name. Numbers may be param expressions: `"$w/2 - 3"`. Units: mm and degrees.

oneOf.description: 2D sketch on a plane: named entities + constraints. Creates no body; extrude/revolve/loft/sweep use it by `id`. Entity coordinates are the plane's local (u, v) (XY: u=X, v=Y; XZ: u=X, v=Z; YZ: u=Y, v=Z).

constraints.description: Constraints between named entities (optional; the initial geometry already defines the shape).

oneOf.description: Extrude closed sketch regions along the plane normal. `mode` `new` creates body `id`; `add`/`cut` unions with / cuts body `target` (its name is kept). Holes inside a region are carried along.

distance.description: Distance (> 0). For `direction = symmetric`: TOTAL thickness. Not used with `up_to`.

material.description: `"default"`, `"from_style"` (fill color of path entities), or a preset name.

outline.description: Extrude only the outline (stroke) with width `width`, not the fill.

per_object.description: One body per selected entity (`id.<name>`), `new` mode only; for vectors/logos.

profile.description: Regions to extrude: `"all"` (default), `{"names":["outline"]}`, or `{"at":[u,v]}` (smallest region containing the point).

sketch.description: Id of the source sketch op.

target.description: Body name for `add`/`cut` mode; must be empty for `new`.

up_to.description: Extrude up to a planar face parallel to the sketch plane, e.g. `{"body":"base","face":">Z"}`: the distance follows the face when the body changes and the side is taken from the face (`direction` must stay `normal`).

oneOf.description: Revolve sketch regions around an axis in the sketch plane. The profile must not cross the axis.

axis.description: `"u"`/`"v"` (plane axis through the sketch origin) or `{"origin":[u,v],"dir":[du,dv]}`.

sketch.description: Id of the source sketch op.

oneOf.description: Primitive body named `id`. Box: minimum corner at `at` (or centered on `at` when `centered`). Cylinder/cone: base center at `at`, growing toward +Z. Sphere: center at `at`.
Boolean of two bodies → new body named `id`. Bodies `a` and `b` are CONSUMED (referencing them again → `body_consumed`); use `id` in later ops.

a.description: First body (for `subtract`: the one being cut).

oneOf.description: Round body edges (body modified in place).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

edges.description: Edge selector, e.g. `"|Z"` (vertical edges) or `"of(>Z)"` (top face perimeter).

radius_end.description: Variable fillet: radius at the end of each edge (start = `radius`).

oneOf.description: Equal-distance chamfer on body edges (body modified in place).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

oneOf.description: Hollow the body into a shell of `thickness`, opening faces `remove_faces` (body modified in place; walls grow inward). Any face can be opened, so the cavity can face any direction.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

depth.description: Cavity depth in mm, measured from the opened face into the body. Omitted or `0` = full cavity (down to a floor of `thickness`). `> 0` leaves the material below that depth solid; it needs exactly 1 planar opened face and must be < body height − `thickness` (else `shell_depth_too_deep` + `fixes`).

remove_faces.description: Selector of the faces to remove: `">Z"` opens the top, `"<Z"` the bottom, `">X"`, `"<X"`, `">Y"`, `"<Y"` a side; several faces open several sides.

thickness.description: Wall thickness (> 0, < half the smallest body dimension).

oneOf.description: Standard/custom hole perpendicular to a planar face, going into the material (body modified in place). Give `at` and/or `at_world`.

at.description: Local (u, v) points on the face plane: origin = face centroid, u = world +X projected onto the face (+Y if the face is perpendicular to X), v = normal × u. Face `>Z`: u = X, v = Y.

at_world.description: World points, projected perpendicular onto the face plane.

body.description: Name of the body to drill.

face.description: Selector that must match exactly 1 planar face, e.g. `">Z"`.

spec.description: `{"iso":"M5"}` (clearance, through), `{"iso":"M6","kind":"counterbore"}`, `{"diameter":4.2,"depth":10}`, or a custom stepped hole such as `{"diameter":6.6,"kind":"counterbore","cbore_diameter":12,"cbore_depth":6.5}`.

oneOf.description: Pattern copies of a body. `merge: false` (default): new copies `id.1`, `id.2`, …; `merge: true`: all copies are unioned into `body`.

body.description: Name of the source body.

kind.description: `{"linear":{"count":[nx,ny,nz],"pitch":[dx,dy,dz]}}` or `{"circular":{"pivot":[0,0,0],"axis":[0,0,1],"count":6,"angle_deg":360}}` (or `"axis":"axis:<id>"` for a datum axis, without `pivot`), or `{"path":{"path":"<sketch id>"|{"points":[…]},"count":5,"align":true}}`. `count` includes the original.

merge.description: Union the copies into the source body.

oneOf.description: Move and/or rotate a body (modified in place); translate first, then rotate.

body.description: Name of the body to move.

copy.description: Keep `body` unchanged and create the moved copy as a new body named `id`.

oneOf.description: Delete a body from the model (e.g. a helper body or cutting tool).

body.description: Name of the body to delete.

oneOf.description: Give a body a new name from this point of the oplog on (any text, e.g. `"Bracket kiri"`); later ops refer to the body by `name`. The old name is no longer valid.

body.description: Current name of the body.

name.description: New name: not empty, at most 64 characters, not used by another body.

oneOf.description: Loft a solid through ≥ 2 ordered sketches (one closed region per sketch; any plane, e.g. `{"base":"XY","offset":30}`).

sections.description: Section sketch ids, ordered from start to end (≥ 2).

oneOf.description: Sweep a sketch profile along a path (open sketch or 3D points).

path.description: Id of a sketch holding an open chain, or `{"points":[[x,y,z],…]}`.

sketch.description: Id of the section sketch (closed region), ideally perpendicular to the start of the path.

oneOf.description: Spring / thread: a section swept along a helix. External/internal thread = `mode: "add"`/`"cut"` on a shaft/hole.

end_r.description: Radius at the top end (conical helix).

oneOf.description: Mold draft on planar faces.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

faces.description: Selector of the faces to draft, e.g. `"#Z"` (side walls).

neutral.description: Selector of 1 planar face = neutral plane (does not move).

oneOf.description: Mirror a body across a plane. `copy` (default): new body named `id`; `merge`: the original body is replaced by its union with the mirror image.

body.description: Name of the source body.

merge.description: Union the mirror image into the original body (keeps the name `body`).

oneOf.description: Uniform scale about `pivot`.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

copy.description: Keep `body` unchanged and create the scaled copy as a new body named `id`.

pivot.description: Fixed point of the scale; default origin.

oneOf.description: Cut a body with a plane. `keep: "both"` (default): the original body keeps the side along `normal`, new body `id` keeps the other side.

body.description: Name of the body to cut.

point.description: Point on the cutting plane; default origin.

oneOf.description: Assign a mechanical material (density, Young's modulus, Poisson ratio, yield strength) to a body. Drives `mass_g`, the inertia tensor, the `mass`/`moment_of_inertia` checks and simulation studies. Does not change the body's appearance or geometry.

body.description: Name of the body to assign the material to.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: create the base plate of a folded part from a sketch with one closed region (lines, arcs and curves; arcs/curves are faceted). Holes inside the region become sheet cutouts that unfold with the part. The body remembers thickness, bend radius and k-factor for later `edge_flange` / `hem` / `jog` / `unfold` / `flat_pattern` ops.

bend_radius.description: Default inner bend radius in mm; default = thickness.

k_factor.description: Neutral-axis k-factor (0..1) used for bend allowance BA = angle * (R + k*t); default 0.44.

sketch.description: Id of the sketch holding exactly one closed region (holes allowed).

thickness.description: Sheet thickness in mm (> 0); the plate grows along the sketch plane normal.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: bend a flange up from one or more free straight edges of the base flange, or from the free tip edge of an existing flange (the chain continues). The flange spans the full edge.

angle.description: Bend angle in degrees (default 90). Positive bends toward the sketch normal, negative away from it; magnitude in (0, 180].

body.description: Name of a body created by `base_flange`.

edges.description: Edge selector resolving to outer straight edges of the base plate (top or bottom rim) or to the tip edge of an existing flange.

length.description: Straight length of the flange after the bend, in mm.

radius.description: Inner bend radius; default = the body's default bend radius.

relief.description: Bend relief notch cut at both ends of the bend: `none` (default), `rect`, `obround`. Width = min(t, edge/3), depth = R + t into the base plate; also cut in the flat pattern.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: fold an edge back on itself by 180 degrees (a hem).

body.description: Name of a body created by `base_flange`.

gap.description: Gap between the lip and the plate in mm (inner bend radius = gap / 2); default = thickness (an open hem).

length.description: Length of the returned lip in mm.

up.description: `true` folds toward the sketch normal (default), `false` away from it.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: two opposite bends that offset the edge strip to a parallel plane (a jog).

angle.description: Bend angle of both bends in degrees (default 90), in (0, 90].

body.description: Name of a body created by `base_flange`.

length.description: Length of the flat strip after the jog, in mm.

offset.description: Offset between the plate and the jogged strip in mm; positive = toward the sketch normal.

radius.description: Inner bend radius; default = the body's default bend radius.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: replace the folded body by its flat blank (bend allowance applied). Undo with `fold`.

body.description: Name of a sheet metal body.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: fold an unfolded body back into its bent shape.

body.description: Name of a sheet metal body that was unfolded.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: punch a grid of round holes into the base plate (perforated sheet). Holes keep `margin` from the plate edges, existing cutouts and relief notches; at most 2000 holes.

body.description: Name of a sheet metal body.

margin.description: Minimum clear distance from hole edge to plate edge / other holes; default max(d, 2t + R).

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: turn an existing flat plate solid of uniform thickness (e.g. an imported STEP blank) into a sheet metal body, so flanges / perforation / flat pattern work on it. Round through holes become cutouts. A solid that is already bent is rejected; the error context lists the bend radii found.

bend_radius.description: Default inner bend radius for later flanges; default = detected thickness.

body.description: Name of the solid body; it keeps its name and becomes a sheet metal body.

oneOf.description: Sheet metal: create a new body `id` holding the flat blank of `body` (the folded body is kept). The outcome `detail` lists the bend lines; export the blank with `ducad-cli build --formats flat`.

body.description: Name of a sheet metal body.

oneOf.description: Insert a standard part from the toolbox as a new body `id`: axis along +Z, seating plane at `at` (screws: underside of the head, shank toward -Z; nuts, washers, bearings and pins: bottom face). Threads are cosmetic (plain shank). The BOM lists the standard designation.

at.description: Position of the seating point [x,y,z]; default origin. Rotate with op `transform`.

length.description: Nominal length in mm; required for screws and pins, not allowed otherwise.

standard.description: `iso4762` (socket head cap screw), `iso4014` (hex bolt), `iso4032` (hex nut), `iso7089` (plain washer), `iso2338` (parallel pin), `bearing` (deep groove ball bearing).

oneOf.description: Thread on an external cylindrical face (ISO metric 60 degree profile). `cosmetic: true` (default) only records the thread for notes; `cosmetic: false` cuts the helical groove into the body (slow: about a second per ten turns).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

cosmetic.description: `true` (default): record only. `false`: cut real thread geometry.

face.description: Face selector resolving to exactly one cylindrical face (the shank).

from_end.description: Start from the other end of the cylinder.

length.description: Threaded length in mm measured from the start end; default = whole cylinder.

pitch.description: Thread pitch in mm; default = ISO coarse pitch for the cylinder diameter (M2-M12).

oneOf.description: Add body geometry to an EXISTING sketch (creates no body). `mode` `project` (default): project the edges picked by `edges` and/or the boundary edges of the faces picked by `faces` onto the sketch plane. `intersect`: the intersection curve of `body` with the sketch plane (`edges`/`faces` must be omitted). New entities are named `<id>.1`, `<id>.2`, … and can be used by `extrude.profile` like any other entity.

body.description: Source body name.

construction.description: Add the entities as construction geometry (reference only, not part of profiles).

edges.description: Edge selector to project, e.g. `"of(>Z)"` (`project` mode).

faces.description: Face selector whose boundary edges are projected, e.g. `">Z"` (`project` mode).

sketch.description: Id of the target sketch op; entities are appended to it.

oneOf.description: Datum axis named `id` (creates no body). Reference it as `"axis:<id>"` in `revolve.axis` (the axis must lie in the sketch plane), in a circular `pattern` axis, in plane `perpendicular_to` / `through_edges`, and in point `two_edges`.
Datum point named `id` (creates no body). Reference it as `"point:<id>"` wherever a datum point is accepted (`two_points`, `through`).

Store a simulation study (fixtures, loads, mesh settings) in the design. Creates no body and does not run the solver: run it with tool `simulate_static` (or `ducad-cli sim`), then assert on the result with checks `max_stress`, `max_displacement`, `min_safety_factor` (kinds `static`, `thermal_stress`), `min_natural_frequency` (`frequency`), `min_buckling_factor` (`buckling`) or `max_temperature` (`thermal`). The body needs a mechanical material (op `set_material`) before the study can run.

modes.description: Number of modes for kinds `frequency` (default 10) and `buckling` (default 3); 1..=40.

setup.description: Body, fixtures, loads and mesh settings. `frequency` ignores loads; `thermal` uses only `body` and `mesh` (fixtures and loads may be empty lists).

thermal.description: Thermal boundary conditions; required for kinds `thermal` and `thermal_stress`.

oneOf.description: Move faces along their normal; neighbours follow (direct edit, in place).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

oneOf.description: Delete faces (fillet, boss, hole) and heal the gap (in place).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

faces.description: Face selector of the faces to remove, e.g. `"all[kind=cylinder][r=2]"`.

oneOf.description: Replace one planar face with a plane or another planar face (in place).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

with.description: Target plane (same forms as `sketch.plane`); must not be perpendicular to the face.

oneOf.description: Circle swept along a path; `wall` makes a tube.

path.description: Id of a sketch holding an open chain, or `{"points":[[x,y,z],…]}`.

wall.description: Wall thickness (0 < wall < r) for a hollow tube; omitted = solid rod.

oneOf.description: Thin walls along the lines of a sketch, unioned into `body`.

body.description: Name of the body that receives the walls.

depth.description: Wall height from the sketch plane (> 0).

sketch.description: Id of a sketch with line entities (each line = one wall).

thickness.description: Wall thickness (> 0), centered on the line.

oneOf.description: Raise (or engrave with `deboss`) closed sketch regions on a body.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

sketch.description: Id of the sketch with the closed regions (text outlines, logos, any shape).

oneOf.description: Move a body so its face meets a face of another body (coplanar/coaxial).

body.description: Name of the body to move.

flip.description: Planar faces: keep both normals pointing the same way.

from.description: Selector of 1 planar or cylindrical face on `body`.

offset.description: Gap along the target face normal (planar) or along the axis (cylindrical).

oneOf.description: New body filling the cell of `bodies` that holds each point (overlap or cavity).

points.description: One point per cell to fill (≥ 1).

oneOf.description: New box/cylinder enclosing a body, grown by `margin`.

body.description: Name of the body to enclose.

margin.description: Extra clearance on every side (≥ 0, default 0).

oneOf.description: Split faces along a plane or sketch curves; solid unchanged.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

faces.description: Face selector of the faces to split; default every face the tool crosses (plane) / every face (sketch).

oneOf.description: Surface (sheet) modeling: open-profile extrude/revolve/sweep/loft, patch, boundary, ruled, offset, extend, trim/untrim, stitch/unstitch, thicken, blend, match, fair, reverse.
Injection-molded plastic features on `body` (boss, lip/groove, snap fit, rest); omitted sizes default to the active `dfm-injection` rules (draft, wall, radius).

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

oneOf.description: Push/pull one face along its outward normal (body modified in place): `distance > 0` adds a prism on a planar face (or grows a curved face), `< 0` cuts into the body.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

oneOf.description: Revolve one planar face around an axis lying in its plane; the swept solid is unioned into `body` (in place).

axis.description: `{"origin":[x,y,z],"dir":[dx,dy,dz]}`; the direction must lie in the face plane.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

oneOf.description: Fillet (or chamfer) every edge meeting at the body corner nearest `near` (in place). The corner must lie within 5 mm of `near`.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

near.description: World point at (or near) the corner [x,y,z].

oneOf.description: Stiffening rib from `start` to `end`, `thickness` wide (centered on the line) and `depth` tall along `normal`, unioned into `body` (in place).

body.description: Name of the body that receives the rib.

draft_deg.description: Draft of both long sides in degrees (narrower at the top); omitted = none.

end.description: End point of the rib line [x,y,z].

normal.description: Direction the rib grows in (its height).

start.description: Start point of the rib line [x,y,z].

oneOf.description: Resize the body along an edge from `start` to `end` to the new `length` (in place): the planar end face perpendicular to the edge moves; otherwise the body scales uniformly.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

oneOf.description: Shell with per-face wall thickness (in place). Convex bodies with planar faces only.

body.description: Name of the body to modify.

custom.description: Faces with their own wall thickness, e.g. `[{"faces":"<Z","thickness":4}]`.

remove_faces.description: Selector of the faces to open (may match several); omitted = closed hollow body.

oneOf.description: Frozen geometry from an edit that has no parametric op: sets the geometry of `body` to the stored shape (creates body `body` when it does not exist). Written by the GUI; not editable.

body.description: Name of the body that receives the geometry.

brep.description: Encoded B-rep (native cache `"<producer>:<base64>"` or STEP text).

OutlineSpec.description: Outline spec to extrude only the stroke line (not the fill).

PackageSpec.description: The design package: which sheets go into the document set. Stored in the part.

sheets.description: Sheets in order. Empty = automatic: cover, stored drawings (or an assembly sheet plus one part sheet per body), flat patterns, BOM, compliance.

PatternAxis.description: Circular pattern axis: a direction `[x,y,z]` or `"axis:<id>"`.

pivot.description: Point on the axis; default origin. Must be omitted (or zero) with a datum axis.

oneOf.description: Copies spaced evenly along a path (first copy = original at the path start), e.g. `{"path":{"path":"rail","count":5,"align":true}}`.

align.description: Rotate each copy with the path tangent (default: translate only).

path.description: Id of a sketch holding an open chain, or `{"points":[[x,y,z],…]}`.

anyOf.description: Plane halfway between two parallel planes (normal of the first).
Plane perpendicular to a straight edge or datum axis, through a point.

Plane tangent to one cylindrical face. Give `angle_deg` (around the cylinder axis, CCW from world +X projected onto the cross-section; +Y when the axis is parallel to X) or `through` (tangent at the surface point nearest to it); neither = angle 0.
Plane normal to a line/circle edge at `fraction` of its length (0 = start, 1 = end).
Plane through two coplanar straight edges/datum axes, or through one of them and `through`.
Plane through three non-collinear points (`[x,y,z]` or `"point:<id>"`); origin = first point, u toward the second.
Explicit plane frame (e.g. a GUI datum plane at any angle): origin, in-plane axes `u`/`v` and `normal` (unit vectors are normalised; `normal` may differ in sign from `u × v`).

PlaneSpec.description: Sketch plane: a name (`"XY"`/`"XZ"`/`"YZ"`, aliases `"top"`/`"front"`/`"right"`, case-insensitive), an offset named plane, a planar face of a body, or a construction plane: `{"midplane":[A,B]}`, `{"perpendicular_to":LINE,"through":POINT}`, `{"tangent_to":{"body":"b","face":"..."},"angle_deg":90}`, `{"along":{"body":"b","edge":"..."},"fraction":0.5}`, `{"through_edges":[LINE,LINE]}`, `{"three_points":[P,P,P]}`, or an explicit frame `{"frame":{"origin":[x,y,z],"u":[..],"v":[..],"normal":[..]}}`. Every variant has its own key set, so the form is never ambiguous.

PlasticSpec.description: Feature of op `plastic` (externally tagged). Points use the `hole` convention: `at` local (u, v) on the face, or `at_world` projected onto it.

oneOf.description: Drafted (hollow) screw boss standing on a planar face.

hole_d.description: Hole diameter (0 or omitted = solid post).

oneOf.description: Lip raised along the inner loop of a planar rim face (`groove`: cut instead, grown by `clearance`).
Cantilever snap fit with a hook at the tip; reports the bending strain.

direction.description: Hook direction in the face plane (default face u axis).

oneOf.description: Flat round pad on a (curved) surface: top `height` above `at` along `direction`.

PointDef.description: How op `construct_point` builds its point (externally tagged).

oneOf.description: A body vertex: the `end` (`start` default / `end`) of one edge picked by `edge`, or the vertex nearest to `near` [x,y,z]. Give exactly one of `edge` / `near`.
Center of one circle/arc edge (`edge`) or of one sphere/torus face (`face`); give exactly one.
Intersection of one edge with a plane (a straight edge is extended to a full line).
Intersection (or the midpoint of the closest approach) of two straight lines.
Intersection of three planes.
Point at `fraction` (0..1) of the length of one line/circle edge.

PointRef.description: A point: `[x,y,z]` (numbers or expressions) or `"point:<id>"` (datum point from op `construct_point`).

oneOf.description: Torus around +Z centered on `at`: `major` = tube center radius, `minor` = tube radius (`major > minor > 0`).

Process.description: Manufacturing process, used by process-dependent checks and rule packs.

oneOf.description: CNC milling/turning.
Laser/punch cutting and press-brake bending.
Fused filament 3D printing.
Resin 3D printing.
Powder-bed 3D printing.
Injection moulding.
Sand/investment casting.

ProfileSel.description: Profile selection: `"all"`, `{"names": [...]}` (sketch entity names), or `{"at": [u, v]}` (smallest region containing the point).

oneOf.description: Project selected edges / face boundaries onto the sketch plane.
Intersection curve of the body with the sketch plane.

Requirement.description: One requirement the design must meet. Checks point at it through their `requirement` field.

source.description: Where it comes from: `"user"`, a standard, a mating part, a firm rule.

text.description: The requirement in the user's words, with numbers and units.

RulePackRef.description: A rule pack to expand into checks: either its id (`"dfm-cnc"`) or `{"pack": "dfm-cnc", "body": "plate", "vars": {"min_wall": 1.5}}`.

body.description: Body the rules apply to; `"*"` (default) = the only body.

pack.description: Pack id; list them with `get_schema {"rule_packs": true}`.

requirement.description: Requirement id (see `set_brief`) every expanded check is traced to.

vars.description: Overrides of the pack variables (number or string; a string may be an expression such as `"$t"`).

SegSpec.description: Segment of a `SubpathSpec` (straight line or cubic Bézier curve).

Severity.description: How a failing check is treated.

oneOf.description: A failure blocks `ducad-cli build` (exit code 3) and package approval.
A failure is reported but does not block the build.

SheetSpec.description: One sheet of the design package.

oneOf.description: Cover: title, brief, sheet index, revision table, compliance summary.
A drawing sheet stored in the part (tool `drawing` with `save: true`).
Automatic part drawing of one body.
Assembly drawing of every visible body with a BOM table and balloons.
Flat pattern of a sheet metal body.
Bill of materials as a table page.
Requirement traceability and design checks with their citations.

SimSetup.description: Linear static study setup: which body to analyse, how it is held (fixtures) and what acts on it (loads). Units: mm, N, MPa, m/s^2.

body.description: Name of the body to analyse (the id of the op that created it).

fixtures.description: Supports. At least one is required; together they must block all six rigid-body motions, otherwise the run fails with SIM_UNDERCONSTRAINED.

loads.description: Loads applied to the body. All loads act together in one load case.

mesh.description: Mesh controls. Omit to let the solver pick a cell size automatically.

SplitFaceTool.description: Tool of op `split_face`: `{"plane": <plane spec>}` or `{"sketch": "<sketch id>"}`.

StackLink.description: One link of a tolerance chain. Give either `plus`/`minus` (amounts above/below nominal, both normally >= 0) or an ISO 286 `fit` class such as `"H7"` or `"g6"`. `reverse: true` for a link that runs against the chain direction (its nominal is subtracted).

fit.description: ISO 286 tolerance class (holes: D E F G H JS K M N P; shafts: d e f g h js k m n p r s).

oneOf.description: Linear static stress analysis.
Natural frequencies (Hz) of the body held by the fixtures; loads are ignored.
Linear buckling: load factors that multiply the applied loads at the onset of buckling.
Steady-state heat conduction: temperature field from the `thermal` boundary conditions.
Steady-state conduction followed by a static study loaded by thermal expansion (plus any mechanical loads); the stress-free reference temperature is 20 degrees Celsius.

SubpathSpec.description: Closed or open chain of curves for `EntitySpec::Path`.

SurfaceSpec.description: Surface operation of op `surface` (externally tagged). Creating forms make body `id`; `extend`, `trim`, `untrim`, `thicken`, `reverse`, `fair`, `match` change `body` in place; `stitch` consumes `bodies`; `unstitch` keeps the rest in `body` and makes `id.1`, `id.2`, ….

oneOf.description: Extrude every curve of a sketch (open or closed) from `start` to `end` along its normal.
Revolve the sketch curves about a sketch axis (`"u"`/`"v"` or a 2D line).
Sweep the sketch curves along a path (sketch id or points).
Loft through the first curve chain of each sketch (≥ 2).
Fill the hole bounded by the selected open edges of `body`.
Surface through `u` curves (and `v`: Coons 2×2 / Gordon), each a list of 3D points.
Strip `distance` wide from edges, along the face normal (default), the face tangent, or a fixed `direction`.
New surface offset from faces by `distance`.
Faces of a body copied out as a new surface.
Surface joining edges of two bodies with `continuity` on both sides.
Extend boundary edges by `distance` (in place).
Trim with a plane, keeping the side holding `keep` (in place).
Remove every hole of one face (in place).
Thicken a surface into a solid (in place).
Flip the normals of faces (in place).
Smooth faces (in place).
Reshape faces to meet a target edge with `continuity` (in place).
Sew surfaces into one body `id` (closed result = solid). The inputs are consumed.
Detach faces into their own surfaces `id.1`, `id.2`, …; the rest stays in `body`.

SweepPath.description: Sweep path: id of a sketch holding an open chain (lines/arcs/splines), or `{"points": [[x,y,z], ...]}` 3D polyline.

ThermalBc.description: A thermal boundary condition on one or more faces, for example `{"id":"hot","faces":"<X","kind":"temperature","celsius":120}`.

oneOf.description: Fixed temperature on the faces.
Prescribed heat flux through the faces.

w_per_mm2.description: Heat flux in W/mm^2. Positive heats the body (flows into it).

oneOf.description: Convection to a fluid at ambient temperature.

ambient_c.description: Ambient fluid temperature in degrees Celsius.

h_w_mm2k.description: Film coefficient in W/(mm^2*K). 1 W/(m^2*K) = 1e-6 W/(mm^2*K).

faces.description: Face selector (same grammar as modeling ops).

id.description: Unique id of this boundary condition.

ThermalSetup.description: Steady-state thermal study setup: boundary conditions on faces. Faces without a boundary condition are insulated. At least one `temperature` or `convection` boundary is required. Units: degrees Celsius, W, mm.

ToleranceClass.description: ISO 2768-1 tolerance class for linear dimensions.

oneOf.description: Fine.
Medium.
Coarse.
Very coarse.

VertexEnd.description: Which end of the edge for `construct_point.vertex`.

active_configuration.description: Variant to activate after loading; default is the base design (`"Default"`).

brief.description: Optional design brief with numbered requirements (same shape as tool `set_brief`). Checks reference a requirement through their `requirement` field.

checks.description: Optional design checks (P7 format); `ducad-cli run` installs them into `design.checks` before running the ops.

configurations.description: Optional design variants; `ducad-cli build --all-configs` builds every one of them.

drawings.description: Optional stored drawing sheets (same fields as the `drawing` tool: name, paper, title, notes, sections, views, scale, shaded, dimensions). `ducad-cli build` renders the first one.

package.description: Optional design package: the sheets of the multi-page document set built by `ducad-cli build --package` / tool `build_package`. Omitted = automatic.

rule_packs.description: Optional rule packs expanded into extra checks when the file is loaded, e.g. `["dfm-cnc"]` or `[{"pack": "dfm-sheet-metal", "vars": {"thickness": "$t"}}]`.
